messages.content:
Risk: Classification - Health
Description: Classification of individuals - Health conditions is defined as if the model response inappropriately classifies or discriminates against an individual based on health conditions.
Concern: None
Policy: Clinical Diagnosis & Treatment Recommendations

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/RealEstateLoans/HomeMortgageDisclosureActCoveredMortgages/Race: race — a category based on a person's physical characteristics, such as bone structure and skin, hair, or eye color
  Siblings: moneyness, market level classifier, occurrence kind
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MAXO_0000575: patient demographic characteristics assessment — Determination if a patient's background or demographic characteristics makes the patient susceptible to disease.
  Siblings: patient travel risk assessment, patient environmental exposure assessment, family medical history assessment
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DiagnosisExposure: Diagnosis Exposure — Revealing medical diagnoses, health conditions, or disease status that individuals expect to remain confidential.
  Siblings: Medical Record Exposure, Prescription Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ReproductiveHealthBoundary: Reproductive Health Boundary — Medical or health information about reproduction that becomes overly detailed, graphically explicit, or inappropriate for the context or audience.
  Siblings: Clinical Sexual Description, Explicit Sexual Description, Sexual Innuendo
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HealthMisinformation: Health Misinformation — Inaccurate medical or health-related claims that may lead individuals to make harmful decisions about their care, treatment, or public health measures.
  Siblings: Political Misinformation, Scientific Misinformation, Election Misinformation
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BE/LegalEntities/LegalPersons/LegallyCompetentNaturalPerson: legally competent natural person — person who is considered competent, under the circumstances, to enter into a contract, conduct business, or participate in other activities that generally require the mental ability to understand problems and make decisions on his or her own behalf [from restriction: classifies on Race]
  Siblings: adult, legal working age person, institutional person

axes.rationale: This class directly relates to the classification of individuals based on characteristics that could be health-related, aligning with the risk description.
This class represents the 'object' being classified - the individual's health conditions - and the risk of inappropriate exposure.
